provenance.source: CAMS global via the Open-Meteo air quality archive, no key
provenance.statistic: mean by calendar month, with the standard deviation between individual years as `spread`
provenance.whatThisIsNot: This is where dust IS, not where it was emitted. Dust raised over the Tigris and Euphrates plain is measured over the Gulf a day later. Use the Ginoux mask and the MERRA-2 emission layer for the emission question. Reading an airborne concentration as a source is the error DUST_EXPOSURE_MODULE_SPEC.md section 7 warns against.
provenance.modelNote: CAMS assimilates satellite aerosol optical depth, so it is observation-constrained, but surface dust is the model's field rather than a measurement at that point.
